annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament, Council and Commission of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Spanish-language text of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, as published in the Official Journal in March 2010. It sets out rights on dignity, freedoms, equality, solidarity, citizens' rights and justice. It contains nothing on AI or robotics, but it is a foundational rights basis for EU digital and AI regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Art. 1: human dignity is inviolable and must be respected and protected
Art. 7-8: respect for private life and protection of personal data, with independent oversight
Art. 21: prohibition of discrimination on any ground
Art. 3: right to physical and mental integrity; free and informed consent in medicine and biology
Art. 52-54: limits on rights, level of protection, prohibition of abuse of rights

annotation.title_en: Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union
